reason: The patch changes the ticker at pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go:77 from `time.Minute * 10` to `time.Minute * 1`, and every tick calls `srv.clean(ctx)` (line 81), which runs all eight cleanup jobs (lines 96-105) with no per-job throttle. `clean` keeps its 9-minute timeout (line 89), so a run longer than a minute is followed immediately by the next one from the buffered tick.
